items.title: How much does the missing check actually expose as the system grows?
items.description: The incident above involved 2 users and 2 invoices — but the missing ownership comparison isn't specific to that size. In a vulnerable design (any authenticated user can fetch any resource by ID), every user can reach every OTHER user's resources. Drag the sliders to see how many ways there are to view someone else's resource. With the fix in place, this number is always 0, regardless of system size.

params.name: numUsers
params.label: Number of users in the system

items.compute: const totalResources = params.numUsers * params.resourcesPerUser; const unauthorizedPaths = totalResources * (params.numUsers - 1); return { unauthorizedPaths, fixedUnauthorizedPaths: 0 };
